Verses.VerseAr: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِىۡ نَزَّلَ الۡـفُرۡقَانَ عَلٰى عَبۡدِهٖ لِيَكُوۡنَ لِلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ نَذِيۡرَۨا ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Blessed is He (Allah) Who sent down to His (most beloved and most intimate) servant the Criterion (the Qur’an) that (draws the difference between right and wrong and) gives judgment in order that he may be a Warner to all the worlds;

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِىۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَلَمۡ يَتَّخِذۡ وَلَدًا وَّلَمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهٗ شَرِيۡكٌ فِىۡ الۡمُلۡكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَىۡءٍ فَقَدَّرَهٗ تَقۡدِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: He (Allah) to Whom belongs the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and Who has not taken (to Himself) any children, nor has He any partner in His Kingdom and He alone has created everything, and then destined (i.e. formatted) it exactly according to a definite estimation (its features, functions, time frame and everything for all the stages of its growth and survival).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً لَّا يَخۡلُقُوۡنَ شَيْئًا ؕ وَّهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُوۡنَ وَلَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ لِاَنۡفُسِهِمۡ ضَرًّا وَّلَا نَفۡعًا وَّلَا يَمۡلِكُوۡنَ مَوۡتًا وَّلَا حَيٰوةً وَّلَا نُشُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And these (polytheists) have taken besides Him other gods which cannot create anything and are themselves created and possess no power either to harm or to benefit themselves and control neither death nor life, nor (have they any authority) to raise up (after death) and assemble.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡۤا اِنۡ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّاۤ اِفۡكٌ ۨافۡتَرٰٮهُ وَاَعَانَهٗ عَلَيۡهِ قَوۡمٌ اٰخَرُوۡنَ‌‌ ۛۚ فَقَدۡ جَآءُوۡ ظُلۡمًا وَّزُوۡرًا ‌ۛ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the disbelievers say: ‘This (Qur’an) is but a lie which this (claimant of Prophethood) has fabricated and other people have helped him in (inventing) it.’ Surely the disbelievers have come down to sheer injustice and falsehood.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡۤا اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ اكۡتَتَبَهَا فَهِىَ تُمۡلٰى عَلَيۡهِ بُكۡرَةً وَّاَصِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they say: ‘(This Qur’an comprises) fables of the ancients which this man has got written; then these (fables) are recited to him morning and evening (in order to memorize and narrate further).’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اَنۡزَلَهُ الَّذِىۡ يَعۡلَمُ السِّرَّ فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفُوۡرًا رَّحِيۡمًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘He (Allah) has sent down this (Qur’an) Who knows all the secrets (present) in the heavens and the earth. Surely He is Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا مَالِ هٰذَا الرَّسُوۡلِ يَاۡكُلُ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشِىۡ فِىۡ الۡاَسۡوَاقِ‌ؕ لَوۡلَاۤ اُنۡزِلَ اِلَيۡهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكُوۡنَ مَعَهٗ نَذِيۡرًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they say: ‘What is the matter with this Messenger? He eats food and walks about in the marketplaces. Why has an angel not been sent down to him that he might (join) him as a Warner?

Verses.VerseAr: اَوۡ يُلۡقٰٓى اِلَيۡهِ كَنۡزٌ اَوۡ تَكُوۡنُ لَهٗ جَنَّةٌ يَّاۡكُلُ مِنۡهَا‌ؕ وَقَالَ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ اِنۡ تَتَّبِعُوۡنَ اِلَّا رَجُلاً مَّسۡحُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or a treasure should have been sent down to him or (at least) he should have owned a garden so that he might eat (of its income).’ And the wrongdoers say (to the Muslims): ‘You are following but a man spellbound.’

Verses.VerseAr: اُنْظُرۡ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبُوۡا لَـكَ الۡاَمۡثَالَ فَضَلُّوۡا فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ سَبِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Esteemed Beloved!) Just see what sort of comparisons they utter for you. So they have gone astray and cannot find any path (to Guidance).

Verses.VerseAr: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِىۡۤ اِنۡ شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيۡرًا مِّنۡ ذٰلِكَ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُۙ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكَ قُصُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Most Blessed is He. If He pleases He can produce gardens for you (far) better than these (here in the world) beneath which streams flow, and raise for you magnificent palaces (but these are not the conditions for a Prophet and Messenger).

Verses.VerseAr: بَلۡ كَذَّبُوۡا بِالسَّاعَةِ‌ وَاَعۡتَدۡنَا لِمَنۡ كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيۡرًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But they have denied the Last Hour (as well), and for everyone who denies the Last Hour We have prepared the blazing Fire (of Hell).

Verses.VerseAr: اِذَا رَاَتۡهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّكَانٍۢ بَعِيۡدٍ سَمِعُوۡا لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَّزَفِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: When that (Fire of Hell) will be visible to them (even) from a distant place, they will hear it raging and roaring.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَاۤ اُلۡقُوۡا مِنۡهَا مَكَانًـا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِيۡنَ دَعَوۡا هُنَالِكَ ثُبُوۡرًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when, tightly bound (together or bound to their satans,) they will be thrown into it from some narrow place, then they will cry out for (their) destruction.

Verses.VerseAr: لَّا تَدۡعُوۡا الۡيَوۡمَ ثُبُوۡرًا وَّاحِدًا وَّادۡعُوۡا ثُبُوۡرًا كَثِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be said to them:) ‘Do not call out (just) for one destruction today but call for many more destructions.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اَذٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ جَنَّةُ الۡخُـلۡدِ الَّتِىۡ وُعِدَ الۡمُتَّقُوۡنَ‌ؕ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَزَآءً وَّمَصِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Is this (a) better (state) or the (life of) eternal Paradise promised to the Godfearing? This is their reward (of deeds) and their abode.

Verses.VerseAr: لَّهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَا يَشَآءُوۡنَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ‌ؕ كَانَ عَلٰى رَبِّكَ وَعۡدًا مَّسۡـُٔوۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: (All) that they long for will be (available) for them in these (gardens of Paradise). They shall live (in it) for ever. That is a coveted promise which your Lord has made a (bountiful) obligation upon Himself (and which will surely be fulfilled).’

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ يَحۡشُرُهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ فَيَقُوۡلُ ءَاَنۡتُمۡ اَضۡلَلۡتُمۡ عِبَادِىۡ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ اَمۡ هُمۡ ضَلُّوۡا السَّبِيۡلَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And on that Day Allah will assemble them together with those they worshipped besides Allah. He will then say: ‘Was it you who led these My servants astray or did they (themselves) go astray from the path?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢۡبَغِىۡ لَنَاۤ اَنۡ نَّـتَّخِذَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِكَ مِنۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَ وَلٰـكِنۡ مَّتَّعۡتَهُمۡ وَاٰبَآءَهُمۡ حَتّٰى نَسُوا الذِّكۡرَ‌ۚ وَكَانُوۡا قَوۡمًۢا بُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will say: ‘Glory be to You. It did not become us (even) to take friends other than You (let alone asking them to worship others besides You). But, (O Lord,) You bestowed upon them and their fathers worldly riches to such an extent that they forgot (even) Your Remembrance. And these were but the (doomed) people to be destroyed.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُوۡكُمۡ بِمَا تَقُوۡلُوۡنَۙ فَمَا تَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ صَرۡفًا وَّلَا نَـصۡرًا‌ۚ وَمَنۡ يَّظۡلِمۡ مِّنۡكُمۡ نُذِقۡهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O disbelievers!) They have denied what you said. So, (now) you can neither avert the torment nor help yourselves. And, (listen,) whoever of you does injustice We will make him taste mighty torment.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ مِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ اِلَّاۤ اِنَّهُمۡ لَيَاۡكُلُوۡنَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمۡشُوۡنَ فِىۡ الۡاَسۡوَاقِ‌ؕ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَعۡضَكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ فِتۡنَةً ؕ اَتَصۡبِرُوۡنَ‌ۚ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We did not send Messengers before you but (that) they certainly ate food and also walked about in the marketplaces (as needed). And We have made you a trial for one another. Will you observe patience (in trial)? And your Lord is All-Seeing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوۡلَاۤ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةُ اَوۡ نَرٰى رَبَّنَاؕ لَـقَدِ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا فِىۡۤ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَعَتَوۡ عُتُوًّا كَبِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who do not hope for meeting with Us say: ‘Why were angels not sent down to us? Or if we could see our Lord (with our own eyes, we would certainly believe).’ In fact they esteem (themselves) very highly in their hearts and are rebelling beyond bounds.

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَ الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةَ لَا بُشۡرٰى يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ لِّـلۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ حِجۡرًا مَّحۡجُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when they will see the angels, there will be no matter of joy for the evildoers anyway on that Day. They will rather say (frightened on seeing them): ‘Would that there were a barricade (which could save us from them! Or the angles, on seeing them, will say: Entry to Paradise is totally forbidden for you.)’

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَدِمۡنَاۤ اِلٰى مَا عَمِلُوۡا مِنۡ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنۡثُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (then) We shall turn to the deeds they (presumably) did (in life) and shall make them scattered dust particles.

Verses.VerseAr: اَصۡحٰبُ الۡجَنَّةِ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ خَيۡرٌ مُّسۡتَقَرًّا وَّاَحۡسَنُ مَقِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: On that Day, the lodging for the inmates of Paradise will be the best and their resting place (too) will be excellent (where they will retire for a nap after the reckoning noon).

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّمَآءُ بِالۡـغَمَامِ وَنُزِّلَ الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةُ تَنۡزِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that Day the sky will be rent asunder, changed into (the resemblance of smoke, like) a cloud, and the angels will be sent down ranks upon ranks.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلۡمُلۡكُ يَوۡمَٮِٕذِ ۨالۡحَـقُّ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ‌ؕ وَكَانَ يَوۡمًا عَلَى الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ عَسِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: That Day True Sovereignty will belong to the Most Kind (Lord) and that will be very hard (i.e. tough) Day on the disbelievers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلٰى يَدَيۡهِ يَقُوۡلُ يٰلَيۡتَنِىۡ اتَّخَذۡتُ مَعَ الرَّسُوۡلِ سَبِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that Day every wrongdoer will bite his hands (in fury and frustration and) will say: ‘Would that I had taken the path (of Guidance by joining) the companionship of the Holy Messenger (blessings and peace be upon him)!

Verses.VerseAr: يٰوَيۡلَتٰى لَيۡتَنِىۡ لَمۡ اَتَّخِذۡ فُلَانًا خَلِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: Ah! Woe to me! Would that I had not taken such a one for a friend!

Verses.VerseAr: لَقَدۡ اَضَلَّنِىۡ عَنِ الذِّكۡرِ بَعۡدَ اِذۡ جَآءَنِىۡ‌ؕ وَكَانَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ لِلۡاِنۡسَانِ خَذُوۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely he led me astray from the direction and guidance after it had come to me, and Satan leaves man helpless and forlorn (in the time of distress).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الرَّسُوۡلُ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ قَوۡمِىۡ اتَّخَذُوۡا هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ مَهۡجُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the (Holy) Messenger (blessings and peace be upon him) will submit: ‘O Lord, surely my people had utterly abandoned this Qur’an.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ‌ؕ وَكَفٰى بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَّنَصِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And that is how We made for every Prophet (their) enemy from the evildoers (who used to oppose their Prophetic mission, and this way, a conflict between the forces of right and wrong would develop and a favourable and congenial environment for revolution would take shape against tyranny, oppression and injustice). And your Lord is sufficient to guide and help.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيۡهِ الۡـقُرۡاٰنُ جُمۡلَةً وَّاحِدَةً‌ ‌ۛۚ كَذٰلِكَ ‌ۛۚ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهٖ فُؤَادَكَ‌ وَرَتَّلۡنٰهُ تَرۡتِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the disbelievers say: ‘Why has the Qur’an not been (put together and) sent down to this (Prophet) in one go?’ It has been revealed gradually (piecemeal) so that by this We may strengthen your (most sanctified) heart, and (that is why) We have recited it gradually with pauses (in order that your heart may feel tranquil by receiving Our Message again and again).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا يَاۡتُوۡنَكَ بِمَثَلٍ اِلَّا جِئۡنٰكَ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَاَحۡسَنَ تَفۡسِيۡرًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And these (disbelievers) do not bring to you any (such) instance (as an objection or inquiry), but We provide you with the Truth (to reply it) and an explanation better (than that).

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ يُحۡشَرُوۡنَ عَلٰى وُجُوۡهِهِمۡ اِلٰى جَهَـنَّمَۙ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَّاَضَلُّ سَبِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: (They) are such people as will be driven headlong towards Hell. It is they who are the worst ones as for their abode and are (also) much distracted from the (straight) path.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَى الۡكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنَا مَعَهٗۤ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوۡنَ وَزِيۡرًا‌ ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We gave Musa (Moses) the Book and appointed his brother Harun (Aaron) with him as his minister (for his help).

Verses.VerseAr: فَقُلۡنَا اذۡهَبَاۤ اِلَى الۡقَوۡمِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَاؕ فَدَمَّرۡنٰهُمۡ تَدۡمِيۡرًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We said: ‘Go both of you to the people who have rejected Our Signs.’ (But when, despite that, they did not abstain from belying Us) We totally destroyed them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَوۡمَ نُوۡحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوۡا الرُّسُلَ اَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ لِلنَّاسِ اٰيَةً‌ ؕ وَاَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ عَذَابًا اَلِيۡمًا ‌ۖ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the people of Nuh ([Noah] as well) — when they denied the Prophets, We drowned them and made them a Sign of warning for (other) people. And We have prepared a painful torment for the wrongdoers.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّعَادًا وَّثَمُوۡدَا۟ وَاَصۡحٰبَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُوۡنًۢا بَيۡنَ ذٰلِكَ كَثِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (We also annihilated) ‘?d and Thamud and the residents of Rass and many (other) people in between.

Verses.VerseAr: وَكُلاًّ ضَرَبۡنَا لَهُ الۡاَمۡثَالَ‌ وَكُلاًّ تَبَّرۡنَا تَـتۡبِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We explained examples to each one (of them for direction and guidance,) but (when they did not refrain from rebellion) We wiped them off completely.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اَتَوۡا عَلَى الۡقَرۡيَةِ الَّتِىۡۤ اُمۡطِرَتۡ مَطَرَ السَّوۡءِ‌ؕ اَفَلَمۡ يَكُوۡنُوۡا يَرَوۡنَهَا‌ۚ بَلۡ كَانُوۡا لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ نُشُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And certainly these (disbelievers) have passed by that town on which was showered a disastrous rain (of stones). Did they not see that (ruined town)? But the truth is that they do not expect to be raised up (after death).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا رَاَوۡكَ اِنۡ يَّتَّخِذُوۡنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًاؕ اَهٰذَا الَّذِىۡ بَعَثَ اللّٰهُ رَسُوۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O Esteemed Beloved,) when they see you they do nothing but make fun of you (and say:) ‘Is this (the one) Allah has sent as a Messenger?

Verses.VerseAr: اِنۡ كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنۡ اٰلِهَتِنَا لَوۡلَاۤ اَنۡ صَبَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا‌ؕ وَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ حِيۡنَ يَرَوۡنَ الۡعَذَابَ مَنۡ اَضَلُّ سَبِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: He had nearly turned us away from our gods, had we not held fast to their (worship).’ And when they see the torment, they will soon realize who was astray.

Verses.VerseAr: اَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰهَهٗ هَوٰٮهُؕ اَفَاَنۡتَ تَكُوۡنُ عَلَيۡهِ وَكِيۡلاًۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you seen him who has taken the desire of his lower self as god? Would you then become a guardian over him?

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ تَحۡسَبُ اَنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ اَوۡ يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ‌ؕ اِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا كَالۡاَنۡعَامِ‌ بَلۡ هُمۡ اَضَلُّ سَبِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do you think that most of them hear or understand? (Nay,) they have become like cattle, rather worse in error than they are.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اِلٰى رَبِّكَ كَيۡفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ‌ۚ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَجَـعَلَهٗ سَاكِنًا‌ۚ ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَا الشَّمۡسَ عَلَيۡهِ دَلِيۡلاًۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you not had a glance of (the Might of) your Lord, how He lengthens the shadow (till noon)? And had He willed He could certainly have made it stationary. Then We have made the sun a proof of this (shadow).

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ قَبَضۡنٰهُ اِلَـيۡنَا قَبۡضًا يَّسِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, drawing this (shadow) little by little towards Ourselves, We roll it up.

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الَّيۡلَ لِبَاسًا وَّالنَّوۡمَ سُبَاتًا وَّجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who has made the night a (wrapper-like) covering for you and made sleep (a means of) rest (for you) and the day a time to get up (for work).

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡۤ اَرۡسَلَ الرِّيٰحَ بُشۡرًۢا بَيۡنَ يَدَىۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖ‌ۚ وَاَنۡزَلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُوۡرًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who sends the breezes as good news before (the rain of) His Mercy. And it is We Who send down pure (and cleansing) water from the sky,

Verses.VerseAr: لِّـنُحْیِۦَ بِهٖ بَلۡدَةً مَّيۡتًا وَّنُسۡقِيَهٗ مِمَّا خَلَقۡنَاۤ اَنۡعَامًا وَّاَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that We may give life with that to (any) dead city and (furthermore) We provide this (water) for drink to many cattle and (nomadic) people that We have created.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَـقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنٰهُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ لِيَذَّكَّرُوْ‌ ۖا فَاَبٰٓى اَكۡثَرُ النَّاسِ اِلَّا كُفُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We keep distributing this (rain) among them (on the scale of different times and cities) so that they may contemplate. Even then most people did not accept (anything) except ingratitude.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَبَـعَثۡنَا فِىۡ كُلِّ قَرۡيَةٍ نَّذِيۡرًا‌ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And had We willed, We would have sent a Warner in every town.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَا تُطِعِ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ وَجَاهِدۡهُمۡ بِهٖ جِهَادًا كَبِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So, (O man of faith,) do not follow the disbelievers and launch a large-scale struggle against them by means of (logic and preaching of the Qur’an).

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ مَرَجَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ هٰذَا عَذۡبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَّهٰذَا مِلۡحٌ‌ اُجَاجٌ ۚ وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَهُمَا بَرۡزَخًا وَّحِجۡرًا مَّحۡجُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who joined two rivers, this (one) very sweet and freshening and that (other one) very salty and bitter. And He set a barrier and a strong partition between them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ مِنَ الۡمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهٗ نَسَبًا وَّصِهۡرًا‌ؕ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who created man from (a sperm drop resembling) water, and made for him (kinship by) lineage and in-laws. And your Lord is All-Powerful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَنۡفَعُهُمۡ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمۡ‌ؕ وَكَانَ الۡـكَافِرُ عَلٰى رَبِّهٖ ظَهِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they (disbelievers) worship besides Allah those (idols) that can neither bring them any profit nor do them any harm. And the disbeliever is (always) a helper (of Satan) in (disobeying) his Lord.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنٰكَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَّنَذِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have not sent you but as a Bearer of good news (for the obedient servants of Allah) and as a Warner (to the rebels).

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ مَاۤ اَسۡـَٔـلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَآءَ اَنۡ يَّـتَّخِذَ اِلٰى رَبِّهٖ سَبِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘I do not ask you for any compensation for this (preaching) but that whoever desires to take a path to (reach) his Lord (may step in).’

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى الۡحَـىِّ الَّذِىۡ لَا يَمُوۡتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهٖ‌ؕ وَكَفٰى بِهٖ بِذُنُوۡبِ عِبَادِهٖ خَبِيۡرَۨا‌ ۛ ۚۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And put your trust in the Ever-Living (Lord) Who will never die, and glorify Him with His praise, and Sufficient is His awareness of the sins of His servants,

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِىۡ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰى عَلَى الۡعَرۡشِ‌ۛۚ الرَّحۡمٰنُ فَسۡـَٔلۡ بِهٖ خَبِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: He Who created the heavenly spheres and the earth and this (universe) in between them in six periods. Then He settled Himself on the Throne (befitting His Majesty. He) is Most Kind. (O aspirant to His gnosis!) Ask of Him someone who has attained to His awareness. (The unaware do not have any gnosis of Him.)

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ قَالُوۡا وَمَا الرَّحۡمٰنُ اَنَسۡجُدُ لِمَا تَاۡمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمۡ نُفُوۡرًا ۩‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when it is said to them: ‘Prostrate yourselves before the Most Kind (Lord),’ the (deniers of the Truth) say: ‘What is the Most Kind Lord? Shall we prostrate ourselves before whatever you command us?’ And this (command) increased only hatred in them.

Verses.VerseAr: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ فِىۡ السَّمَآءِ بُرُوۡجًا وَّجَعَلَ فِيۡهَا سِرٰجًا وَّقَمَرًا مُّنِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Most Blessed and Most Glorified is He Who made vast mansions of heavenly spheres (in the form of galaxies) in the heavenly cosmos and made (the sun) in it a (light-generating and heat-emitting) lamp and a shining moon (in the solar system).

Verses.VerseAr: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلۡفَةً لِّمَنۡ اَرَادَ اَنۡ يَّذَّكَّرَ اَوۡ اَرَادَ شُكُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He is the One Who made the day and the night rotate after each other for him who desires to contemplate or intends to be grateful. (There is direction and guidance in these creative powers.)

Verses.VerseAr: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الَّذِيۡنَ يَمۡشُوۡنَ عَلَى الۡاَرۡضِ هَوۡنًا وَّاِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الۡجٰهِلُوۡنَ قَالُوۡا سَلٰمًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the (favourite) servants of the Most Kind (Lord) are those who walk gently on the earth and when the ignorant (i.e. impolite) people say to them something (unlikable) they (get aside) saying: ‘Peace.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَبِيۡتُوۡنَ لِرَبِّهِمۡ سُجَّدًا وَّقِيَامًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (these) are the ones who spend their nights prostrating themselves and standing before their Lord (cloaked in submissiveness).

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ رَبَّنَا اصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَـنَّمَ‌ۖ اِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا‌ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (these) are the people who pray (all the time before the Presence of Allah): ‘O our Lord, turn away from us the torment of Hell. Surely its torment is most injurious (and everlasting).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّهَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرًّا وَّمُقَامًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely that is an evil lodging (for temporary lodgers) and an evil abode (for permanent dwellers).’

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اِذَاۤ اَنۡفَقُوۡا لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُوۡا وَلَمۡ يَقۡتُرُوۡا وَكَانَ بَيۡنَ ذٰلِكَ قَوَامًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (these) are the people who are neither extravagant nor miserly when they spend. And their spending is (based on) a balance between the two extremes (of extravagance and miserliness).

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَدۡعُوۡنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلُوۡنَ النَّفۡسَ الَّتِىۡ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بِالۡحَـقِّ وَلَا يَزۡنُوۡنَ‌ۚ وَمَنۡ يَّفۡعَلۡ ذٰلِكَ يَلۡقَ اَثَامًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And these are the people who do not worship any other god apart from Allah, nor do they kill the soul whose killing without any just cause Allah has forbidden, and nor do they commit adultery. And whoever does this will receive the punishment due for the sin.

Verses.VerseAr: يُضٰعَفۡ لَهُ الۡعَذَابُ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وَيَخۡلُدۡ فِيۡهٖ مُهَانًا ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: His punishment will be doubled on the Day of Rising and disgraced and humialted he will live in it forever.

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّا مَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلاً صَالِحًـا فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللّٰهُ سَيِّاٰتِهِمۡ حَسَنٰتٍ‌ؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوۡرًا رَّحِيۡمًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: But whoever repents and believes and does good deeds, so these are the people whose evil deeds Allah will change into good ones. And Allah is Most Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًـا فَاِنَّهٗ يَتُوۡبُ اِلَى اللّٰهِ مَتَابًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whoever repents and executes good, so he returns to Allah (the way) returning is due.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَشۡهَدُوۡنَ الزُّوۡرَۙ وَاِذَا مَرُّوۡا بِاللَّغۡوِ مَرُّوۡا كِرَامًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And these are the people who do not attend, (both verbally and practically,) the false and untruthful matters, and when they pass by evil activities, they pass on (observing caution) with utmost nobility and dignity.

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَمۡ يَخِرُّوۡا عَلَيۡهَا صُمًّا وَّعُمۡيَانًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And these are the people who, when they are directed and guided by means of Revelations of their Lord, do not fall at them deaf and blind (but reflect on them).

Verses.VerseAr: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَـنَا مِنۡ اَزۡوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ اَعۡيُنٍ وَّاجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ اِمَامًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And these are the people who submit (before the Presence of Allah): ‘O our Lord, grant us coolness of eyes in our wives and our children, and make us leaders of the Godfearing people.’

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ يُجۡزَوۡنَ الۡغُرۡفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡا وَيُلَقَّوۡنَ فِيۡهَا تَحِيَّةً وَّسَلٰمًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will be rewarded with lofty palaces (in Paradise) as recompense for their patience and steadfastness and will be welcomed therein with greetings and salutations of Peace.

Verses.VerseAr: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا‌ؕ حَسُنَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرًّا وَّمُقَامًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will live therein forever. Those (lofty palaces in Paradise) are the most excellent lodgings and (decent) abodes.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَـؤُا بِكُمۡ رَبِّىۡ لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡ‌ۚ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُوۡنُ لِزَامًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘My Lord cares little for you if you do not worship (Him). But you have indeed rejected (Him). So now this (denial) will ever endure as permanent torment (for you).’
